تنافعت (form VI)
# تَنَافَعْتُ (tanāfaʕtu) /ta.naː.faʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
# تَنَافَعْتَ (tanāfaʕta) /ta.naː.faʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
# تَنَافَعْتِ (tanāfaʕti) /ta.naː.faʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
# تَنَافَعَتْ (tanāfaʕat) /ta.naː.fa.ʕat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
